refined_prompts.verbose_refined_v4:
Parse todo items. Today: Tuesday, 2026-01-27.

TASK: Extract structured data from input, OR reject non-actionable requests.

VALID: tasks, intentions ('ich muss...'), plans with dates, reminders.
INVALID: questions, speculative thoughts ('ich glaube...'), observations, general chat.

OUTPUT JSON (all keys required):
{"rejected": bool, "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "title": str|null, "note": str|null, "due": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM"|null, "context": str, "project": str}

RULES: JSON output only. Retain the input language (German). ALWAYS assign context and project using preferred tags if applicable. If an existing tag matches (case-insensitive), use the EXACT existing case.

Prioritize these tags: Projects: haushalt, arbeit, privat, gesundheit, finanzen. Contexts: einkaufen, telefon, computer, termin, arbeit, zuhause.

Dates are always relative to today. If no time is given, use 00:00.

Example: 'Kaufe morgen Milch' -> {"rejected": false, "confidence": 0.95, "title": "Kaufe Milch", "note": null, "due": "2026-01-28T00:00", "context": "einkaufen", "project": "haushalt"}
Example: 'ich glaube ich gehe schwimmen' -> {"rejected": true, "confidence": 0.9, "title": null, "note": null, "due": null, "context": null, "project": null}
